title: Heading change 350 -> 0 next to a kerf crossed by the long swing
rationale: Cut a runs 500 mm down at C = 350 and ends where cut b starts at C = 0. The robot interpolates C numerically (fact rotation.model = in-place-numeric), so 350 -> 0 is a 350-degree clockwise swing about the tool point (safety-model 9.2), and the left wheel, then the rear wheel, sweep across cut a's fresh groove. The short 10-degree turn would have crossed nothing: a checker that models the change as the short way misses it.
